source_interfaces.summary: UIF shared infrastructure source; importing this package starts no services.

Pure continuity decisions for the existing supervised delivery lifecycle.

The eventual shared authority serializes/persists these transitions. This
module creates no role, queue, allocator, lease, API credential or dispatch.
Typed, code-injected evidence verification is mandatory; caller JSON booleans
cannot qualify a probe, capacity or operation outcome.

Private, single-host claim persistence, never a work selector or queue.

The stable lock, expected-byte digest, file fsync, atomic replacement and
directory fsync follow the independently reviewed OwnerAuthority primitives at
UIF PR42 e40103c55f749a3a2835f8d14ad7f10ab87a5a3d, owner_runtime.py:158-205.
This implementation deliberately imports neither that ledger nor its coordinator.
All clients must reach the same Foo-hosted authority. No distributed-lock or
host-outage recovery guarantee is implied.

Normalize retained legacy source-free evidence without granting acceptance.

This pure receipt builder performs no reads, writes, claims, dispatch or Git
publication. The caller must authenticate the original published tuple and use
the existing native receiver/fence for any effect. It never manufactures the
modern reviewed_disposition field or treats a mutable latest settlement as input.

Match an issue presentation to a caller-authenticated native scope digest.

This pure projection neither authenticates the expected digest nor grants scope,
claim, admission, checkpoint, review or publication authority.

Thin, explicitly installed seams for native Stokowski's existing lifecycle.

The observed native launcher remains unchanged. An integration owner must wire
dispatch BEFORE native _dispatch/_run_worker metadata, wrap every metadata and
publication effect, and route _schedule_retry through this boundary. Merely
importing this module, running tests or constructing it does not fence upstream.
No polling loop, selector, queue, ledger coordinator or provider client is added.

Bounded JSON adapter for an existing authenticated Foo command transport.

No network, shell execution, installation or service control occurs here. The
transport still uses its existing command/cwd/job_id/timeout_seconds fields.
This CLI's authenticated principal is the actual OS uid. Installed transport
adapters may use Registry with their independently authenticated principal.
Claim/effect admission additionally needs an owner-installed RecoveryVerifier;
this conservative standalone adapter cannot manufacture one from input JSON.

Source-only quota handoff controls for the existing Stokowski lifecycle.

Linear remains the work system. This private registry records claims, operation
intents and mode only; it never selects work, invokes a model, changes Linear,
starts a service or wakes a cloud session. Installed native/publisher/MCP
adapters must call these guards before effects. Unadapted executors are not fenced.
